name: Performance Weapon Mastery
benefit:
You treat all weapons you are proficient in as if they had the performance weapon quality (page 144).
## Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
**Source** Pathfinder Unchained pg. 128
As long as you have at least 1 stamina point in your stamina pool, you treat all weapons—not just the ones you are proficient with—as if they had the performance weapon quality.
flavor: You wield all your weapons with the flair of a performer.
